title: Lessons learned on language model safety and misuse
summary: We describe our latest thinking in the hope of helping other AI developers address safety and misuse of deployed models.
body: We describe our latest thinking in the hope of helping other AI developers address safety and misuse of deployed models.
summaryZh: OpenAI分享了在语言模型安全性和防范模型滥用方面的最新思考与经验总结，旨在帮助AI开发者更好地应对已部署模型的安全治理与风险防范。原始信息显示：We describe our latest thinking in the hope of helping other AI developers address safety and misuse of deployed models.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Lessons learned on language model safety and misuse”。其重要性主要体现在：总结了大语言模型安全与滥用防范的经验教训，对模型部署和治理有参考意义。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
